description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.
